Implementation contract at 0x77684815f44b28726bc3efa4471b88ef3b93feb0 (DSToken), deployed 2025-10-29, verified via Etherscan
RWA.xyz tracked asset showing Ethereum deployment with token supply 103,609.69 and 4 holders as of snapshot
No audit links recorded in pinned data; Etherscan shows 'No Contract Security Audit Submitted' for implementation
GitHub not recorded in pinned data; no deployment artifacts discovered

No factory pattern detected; STAC is token contract (not factory) with limited child enumeration scope
Identified role: 'token' for STAC proxy; implementation is DSToken (standard token contract); owner and admin roles managed via transparent proxy pattern
Two contracts mapped: proxy (0x51c2d74017390cbbd30550179a16a1c28f7210fc) and implementation (0x77684815f44b28726bc3efa4471b88ef3b93feb0); both fetched from Etherscan

protocol_metadata.about: Securitize Tokenized AAA CLO Fund (STAC) is a tokenized investment vehicle providing institutional investors on-chain access to AAA-rated collateralized loan obligations. Developed in collaboration with BNY (custodian and sub-advisor), the fund invests primarily in U.S. dollar-denominated AAA-rated CLO tranches from primary and secondary markets, enabling fractional ownership and transparent settlement via Ethereum-based ERC-20 tokens.
